notes: Thirty-two questions across all eight required categories and all three difficulties. Every expectation is expressed as TOPIC COVERAGE, never as a canonical answer string and never as a URL (FR-040, FR-063, FR-064). That is a deliberate consequence of the corpus being ingested by URL from documentation the publisher reorganises whenever they like: a dataset pinned to today's page structure would report a false regression the first time Atlassian renames a heading, and would report it as a retrieval regression when nothing about retrieval changed. contracts/evaluation-dataset.schema.json has additionalProperties: false and no URL field anywhere, so a pinned source cannot be introduced through a new property either. --- The 'unsupported' bucket is the deliberately-unanswerable set behind SC-008. Four questions are in it, all plausible-looking questions about things this corpus genuinely does not document, which is harder than asking about something obviously absurd. They must be refused with zero fabricated facts and zero fabricated citations. Retrieval metrics are null for them — not applicable to the question, not zero, and not a failure. --- 'topics' entries are each one checkable assertion rather than a topic label, so claim coverage (SC-006) is measurable. Where several phrasings are equally correct, they are listed in acceptable_alternatives rather than by widening 'topics', because widening topics makes coverage unfalsifiable. --- Independent technical demonstration. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Atlassian. Questions are written from a user's point of view, not from any internal knowledge of the system. --- 2026-10-02 anchor audit: the 25 questions with an authored heading path matched 0 real corpus pages (not one segment). Paths were re-derived from verified pages (anchored), cleared where no corpus page exists (no-corpus-page / partially-anchored keeps the closest real page), and the four 'unsupported' questions keep must_refuse=true. Authored paths are preserved in each question's notes for audit.
